annotations.title: Text-to-Structured Date, Money & Unit Parser API

description: Text-to-Structured Date, Money & Unit Parser API: Normalize messy EU/US prices, dates, percentages, and measurements into structured JSON. (Endpoint: POST /v1/locale-value-parser)

locale_hint.description: Disambiguates ambiguous date formats (DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY) and currency symbols.

reference_time.description: ISO-8601 reference timestamp for relative dates ('tomorrow', 'next Friday 5pm CET').

text.description: Messy string containing money, dates/times, and/or physical units.
text.example: Invoice total: 1.234,50 Ft due next Friday 5pm CET (weight: 5 ft 10 in)

name: tinplate_locale_value_parser
